summary: Iter15 tests: backend 10/10 PASS (audit-logs filters+CSV export, team /api/teams/calendar). Frontend Admin Audit Logs page works perfectly — filters (action/search/date), Clear filters, Export CSV all functional (network call 200 text/csv; charset=utf-8 with Content-Disposition attachment). Team Calendar tab works perfectly — appears between Reminders and Chat, prev/next/today nav refetches per month, member filter, day cell click opens cal-day-detail with close. CRITICAL REGRESSION: Landing page renders BLANK (white screen, 0 headings) due to runtime error 'PaperPlaneTilt is not defined' — Landing.js refactor missed importing the PaperPlaneTilt icon used in demo chat send button.

ui_bugs.issue: PaperPlaneTilt is not defined — runtime ReferenceError makes the entire landing page blank (white screen, 0 headings rendered). Likely missed import after landingData.js refactor. Used inside demo chat send button.

action_items: Add `PaperPlaneTilt` to the @phosphor-icons/react imports at the top of /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.js — currently icons imported are { ArrowRight, Play, Check, Star, Globe, CheckCircle, Sparkle, CaretRight, X, List, ArrowUp } and PaperPlaneTilt is missing. Without it, the entire marketing landing page is broken for anon visitors.
After fix, regression-verify: hero, features, pricing, FAQ, testimonials, demo chat input render and no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.js refactor (iter15) introduced a missed icon import causing 100% landing page outage — recommend a lint rule (no-undef) gate before deploy
TeamCalendarTab uses monthKey in useCallback deps with eslint-disable — acceptable but could be cleaner with explicit year/month deps

success_rate.frontend: 66% (Audit + Team Calendar pass; Landing CRITICAL FAIL)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing 3 audit logs and team data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints fully validated (10 tests). Admin Audit Logs UI + Team Calendar UI confirmed working end-to-end. ONLY remaining issue is the missing PaperPlaneTilt import in Landing.js. After main agent adds the import, just reload landing in incognito and verify text renders + no console errors.
rca of the issue: Landing.js was refactored to move static data arrays into /app/frontend/src/data/landingData.js. The icon `PaperPlaneTilt` (used by the live-demo chat send button inside Landing.js JSX) was not added to the @phosphor-icons/react named import list, producing runtime `ReferenceError: PaperPlaneTilt is not defined` during render → React unmounts the whole tree → white screen. Reproduction: open / in any browser as anon — pageerror fires, body innerText length is 0, 0 h1/h2/h3 elements. Fix: add `PaperPlaneTilt` to the import block at top of Landing.js (line 5-8).
